_comment: Skills sync FLAT to skills_path. NEVER nest skills under tier/domain subfolders — Genie Code auto-loads from the top level of skills_path only. This Greenwood reference maps tiers to a dev->staging->prod SDLC (NOT one-workspace-per-domain): Tier 1 is self-uploaded to DEV and never CI-synced; Tier 2 (every domain) syncs to STAGING; Tier 3 (enterprise) syncs to ALL THREE workspaces. The tier->reach model is what generalizes; the domain list and URLs are illustrative placeholders.
notes: Workspace roles: DEV=greenwood-dev (self-upload/dogfood, Tier 1 only), STAGING=greenwood-staging (Tier 2 team-integration target), PROD=greenwood-prod. Tier 1 never syncs. Tier 2 syncs each domain's skill folders to skills_path on STAGING — a shared team-integration workspace. Tier 3 syncs to skills_path on every workspace in tier3.workspaces (dev+staging+prod). In a real topology each domain would map to its own workspace(s); only this mapping changes, the scripts and CI do not. Each target workspace needs a CI service principal valid there (account-level OAuth M2M) with CAN_MANAGE on skills_path.
